name: trello_list_choice_must_offer_both
description: A long request that never says where the cards go. push_tasks_to_trello returns needs_user_choice with two options and the instruction 'Offer BOTH'. Having boards already does not mean the user wants this project's cards in one of them.

turns.message: Oye necesito tener Onebox2026 controlado en Trello, subeme todo lo que este pendiente, ordenado, y que quede donde lo vea el equipo

assert.comment: Silently picking one of the two boards is the failure this pins down.
